title: Mediterranean Omelette
description: A flavorful and light omelette filled with the taste of the Mediterranean, perfect for any meal. This dish is packed with protein and can be made in under 20 minutes.

ingredients.name: Mediterranean Omelette Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: A blend of herbs and spices found in mediterranean cuisine

ingredients.name: Light Feta Cheese
ingredients.notes: Crumbly feta cheese for added protein and flavor

instructions: 1. Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together. Add the mediterranean omelette spice mix and mix well.
2. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add a small amount of oil.
3. Pour the egg mixture into the pan and let it cook for 2-3 minutes.
4. Sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese over half of the omelette.
5. Use a spatula to gently fold the other half of the omelette over the feta cheese.
6. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the eggs are cooked through.
7. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
